result:
Untagged Slack replies in a thread PostHog already owns were governed by a per-person follow-up mode (always, ask, or never). A missing choice was stored as null and treated as never, so the reply was dropped in the webhook and the person was never asked.

Null is now “never chosen,” not never. An explicit mode is unchanged: always still forwards with no prompt, never still drops with no prompt, and ask still shows the existing yes/no prompt. The thread creator’s explicit choice still wins for every reply in threads they started. When the creator has not chosen, the replier’s own mode is used instead.

When neither person has chosen, the reply still goes through the existing classifier. If it looks agent-directed, the replier gets an ephemeral prompt: send this message, skip it, or save a default. Saving writes the same `untagged_followup_mode` column the App Home picker edits (`auto`, `ask`, or `never`) on the clicker’s row, so the next reply follows that mode and the onboarding prompt does not repeat. “Yes, take a look” and “No thanks” still apply only to this message.

The Home tab shows that picker even when nothing is stored, with no option preselected, so unset does not look like “leave them alone.” Choosing a value there updates the same setting.

+    def _action_ids(self, offer_default: bool) -> set[str]:
+        blocks = _untagged_followup_prompt_blocks("tok", offer_default=offer_default)
+        return {
+            element["action_id"]
+            for block in blocks
+            if block.get("type") == "actions"
+            for element in block["elements"]
+        }
+
+    def test_ask_prompt_does_not_offer_a_default(self):
+        ids = self._action_ids(False)
+        assert UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_RUN in ids
+        assert UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_DISMISS in ids
+        assert UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_REMEMBER_AUTO not in ids
+
+    def test_unset_prompt_offers_the_same_modes_as_the_home_tab(self):
+        ids = self._action_ids(True)
+        assert {
+            UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_RUN,
+            UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_DISMISS,
+            UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_REMEMBER_AUTO,
+            UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_REMEMBER_ASK,
+            UNTAGGED_FOLLOWUP_ACTION_REMEMBER_NEVER,
+        } <= ids
